decks.notes: This Esper Aggro deck focuses on a fast, aggressive playstyle with a mix of powerful creatures and removal spells. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early creature aggression from cards like Luminarch Aspirant and Tenacious Underdog, while also disrupting their game plan with removal spells like Vanishing Verse and The Meathook Massacre. The deck also includes some card advantage with Raffine, Scheming Seer and can close out games quickly with powerful finishers like Lolth, Spider Queen and Legion Angel.

This Jund Control deck focuses on using a combination of removal spells, powerful creatures, and card advantage engines to control the board and outvalue opponents. Key cards such as Goldspan Dragon, Ob Nixilis, the Adversary, and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker help generate card advantage and put pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes a mix of ramp cards like Prosperous Innkeeper and powerful finishers like Moonveil Regent and Magda, Brazen Outlaw. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the triple color requirements of the deck while also providing utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Ziatora's Proving Ground.

This deck focuses on a aggressive strategy using a mix of creatures, removal spells, and disruptive spells to control the game early on. It aims to pressure the opponent quickly with a combination of efficient creatures like Kaito Shizuki and Tenacious Underdog, while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Duress and Vanishing Verse. The deck also has a strong late-game presence with powerful cards like Lolth, Spider Queen and The Meathook Massacre. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive strategy with a mix of pathways and utility lands.

This Naya Aggro deck focuses on generating quick and consistent aggression through a combination of low-cost creatures and powerful enchantments. By utilizing cards like Generous Visitor and Kami of Transience to maintain a strong board presence, as well as utilizing Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Showdown of the Skalds to quickly boost power and provide card advantage, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents early in the game. Additionally, the inclusion of Runes and pathways allows for flexibility and versatility in adapting to various board states and strategies.

The main concept of this deck revolves around utilizing a combination of aggressive creatures and removal spells to control the board while applying pressure on the opponent. The deck includes powerful creatures like Kaito Shizuki, The Wandering Emperor, and Luminarch Aspirant, along with removal spells such as Vanishing Verse and Void Rend to deal with opposing threats. Additionally, cards like Obscura Interceptor and Raffine, Scheming Seer provide card advantage and flexibility in different situations. The mana base is also optimized with pathways and utility lands to ensure consistent casting of spells throughout the game.
